text:
Type: molded shell dining chair
Use: dining, working at a desk; dining room, kitchen, home office
Style: mid-century modern, Scandinavian, retro
Materials: molded plastic shell, solid birch legs, grey metal underframe
Colors: light sky blue, light natural birch, grey
Shape: one-piece curved scoop shell with a tall rounded back, armless, four splayed round tapered wooden legs, slim and light, compact
Feel: fresh, cheerful, airy, soft
Goes with: white or light wood tables, pastel or white walls; Scandinavian or mid-century modern dining rooms, bright kitchens
